tweetText: Mark Zuckerberg told Meta staff that AI agents aren't advancing as fast as he expected. This highlights the challenges tech companies face in rapidly evolving AI landscape. via TechCrunch AI

Jersey Mike's IPO documents surprisingly highlight AI, reflecting the trend of companies jumping on the AI bandwagon, regardless of relevance. This shows how inflated the AI hype has become across various industries. via TechCrunch AI

Meta has launched Pocket, an AI app that allows users to create and share mini games through text prompts. This could change how we engage with gaming by making it more accessible and creative. via TechCrunch AI

Anthropic is in talks with Samsung to develop a new custom chip for AI. This move highlights the growing competition in AI hardware, following OpenAI's recent partnership with Broadcom. via TechCrunch AI

OpenAI's CEO Sam Altman suggested donating 5% of the company's equity to a U.S. sovereign wealth fund. This move could allow the public to benefit from the profits generated by the AI industry's growth. via TechCrunch AI

Microsoft has launched its own AI deployment company, committing $2.5 billion to the initiative. This move strengthens its position in the AI race alongside Amazon, OpenAI, and Anthropic. via TechCrunch AI
Ben Guez is using an automated script called OpenClaw to connect with potential partners on Instagram. This highlights how AI is changing dating by automating social interactions. via TechCrunch AI
Cursor aims to keep providing access to OpenAI and Anthropic's AI models after being bought by SpaceX. This move could reshape partnerships in the competitive AI landscape. via WIRED AI

OpenAI is considering giving the US government a 5% stake in the company to ease tensions with the Trump administration and address public concerns about AI. This move could reshape the relationship between tech and government amidst growing scrutiny. via The Verge AI

AI is being integrated with frameworks like Lean Six Sigma and BPM to improve operational efficiency in businesses. This blend promises to streamline processes and enhance quality control, making organizations more effective. via MIT Technology Review.
